shape: a small thing you fought as a kid and would welcome now, pinned to one object

slides.text: i fought you for the red pen in class, but now i’d let you borrow it for my own notes.

caption:
the red pen was the trophy of our classroom battles
the ink still smells like fresh worksheets
the desk now feels like a silent high‑five
send this to the teacher who always saves the extra eraser for you

#childhoodmemories #schoolmemories
